name: encode_regulon_contrast
description: LOO binding-prevalence-background-corrected regulon contrast sets (specific_Up/promiscuous_Down) from per-factor ENCODE TF ChIP-seq or eCLIP target-gene collections

inputs.name: regulon_dir
inputs.description: Directory of per-factor regulon set subdirectories. Each subdir must contain geneset.tsv (header: gene) and optionally geneset.meta.json with a 'target' field for the factor name (TF symbol or RBP name). Typical source: output of an encode_regulons converter or the derive_encode_target_regulons.py reference script.

inputs.name: regulon_zip
inputs.description: Zip archive of per-factor regulon set subdirectories. Alternative to regulon_dir.

parameters.name: assay
parameters.help: Assay label for set names and provenance. Use 'TF ChIP-seq' (default) or 'eCLIP'.

parameters.name: lib_prefix
parameters.help: Prefix for output set names. Defaults to 'ENCODE_<safe_assay>_regulon_bgcorrected'.

parameters.name: low_prevalence
parameters.help: LOO-prevalence ceiling for specific_Up sets. A gene is Up if this factor binds it AND its prevalence across all other factors is below this threshold (default: 0.25). Removes promiscuous/HOT-region binding.

parameters.name: high_prevalence
parameters.help: LOO-prevalence floor for promiscuous_Down sets. A gene is Down if this factor does NOT bind it AND its prevalence across all other factors is above this threshold (default: 0.75). Identifies broadly-bound genes absent from this factor.

outputs.name: <lib_prefix>_<target>_specific_Up/genesets.gmt
outputs.description: Genes specifically targeted by this factor (LOO-prevalence < low_prevalence)

outputs.name: <lib_prefix>_<target>_specific_Up/geneset.tsv
outputs.description: Gene list for the specific_Up set

outputs.name: <lib_prefix>_<target>_promiscuous_Down/genesets.gmt
outputs.description: Commonly-bound genes absent from this factor (LOO-prevalence > high_prevalence)

outputs.name: <lib_prefix>_<target>_promiscuous_Down/geneset.tsv
outputs.description: Gene list for the promiscuous_Down set
